fact.livelihood: What work does your family do?
fact.registered_fisher: Is the person applying a registered fisher?
fact.active_fisher: Does the person applying still work as a fisher (an active fisher)?
fact.bpl: Is your family in the BPL (below poverty line) category?
fact.bank_account: Does the person applying have a bank account?
fact.traditional_fisher: Is the person applying a registered traditional fisher?
fact.kfwfb_member: Is the person a member of the Kerala Fishermen's Welfare Fund Board (Matsyaboard)?
fact.age: How old is the person applying?
fact.plantation_member: Is the worker a member of the Small Plantation Workers Welfare Fund?
fact.unable_due_infirmity: Is the member unable to work due to infirmity?
fact.permanent_disability: Does the member have a permanent disability?
fact.daughter_marriage: Is there a marriage to apply for: a woman member's own marriage, or the marriage of a member's daughter?
fact.female_member: Is the person applying a woman?
fact.matsyafed_society_member: Is the person a member of a fishermen cooperative society affiliated to Matsyafed?
fact.kfwfb_contributions_paid: Are the Fishermen Welfare Fund Board contributions fully paid, with no arrears?
fact.kfwfb_membership_years: How many years ago was the first Welfare Fund Board contribution paid?
fact.fisher_work_10_years: Has the person worked and earned a living as a fisherman in Kerala for at least 10 years?
fact.retired_from_fishing: Has the person stopped fishing work (retired)?
fact.annual_family_income: What is your family's total income in a year?
fact.kfwfb_family_status: Which of these describe your family? Choose all that apply.
option.kfwfb_family_status.widow_of_fish: Widow of a fisherman who was a Board member
option.kfwfb_family_status.bride_is_fish: The bride herself is a fisherworker
option.kfwfb_family_status.fisher_parent: The bride's fisherman parent has died
fact.prior_marriage_assistance: Has the family received this Welfare Fund marriage assistance before?
fact.bride_18: Will the bride have completed 18 years on the marriage date?
fact.death_by_accident: Was the death caused by an accident?
fact.deceased_under_60: Was the fisherman below 60 years of age when he died?
fact.deceased_active_after_60: If he was 60 or older: was he still working, on the fishermen list, and paying contributions regularly?
fact.death_within_3_months: Did the death happen within the last 3 months (90 days)?
fact.regular_income_job: Does the widow have a job with a regular income?
fact.accident_within_3_months: Did the accident happen within the last 3 months?
fact.family_event: Has any of these happened in the family? Choose all that apply.
option.family_event.daughter_marriage: A daughter is getting married, or married in the last 60 days
option.family_event.sslc_8_aplus: A child got A+ in at least 8 subjects in this year's SSLC
option.family_event.serious_illness: Someone needs treatment for heart disease, kidney disease, cancer, a brain tumour, paralysis, or a mental illness that can be cured
option.family_event.accident: A fisherman was hurt in an accident and could not work for 7 days or more
option.family_event.member_death: A fisherman in the family who was a Welfare Fund member has died
option.family_event.dependant_death: In the last 3 months, a fisherman's father, mother, wife or husband, minor son or unmarried daughter died
option.family_event.delivery: A woman in the family is expecting a baby or has just given birth
option.family_event.plus_two_all_aplus: A child got A+ in all subjects in the Higher Secondary (+2) or VHSE final exam, passing in the first attempt
fact.plantation_membership_years: For how many years has the worker been a continuous member of the Small Plantation Workers Welfare Fund?
fact.incapacitated_over_2_years: Has the member been continuously and permanently unable to work for more than two years?
fact.plantation_member_death: Has a member of the Small Plantation Workers Welfare Fund in your family died?
fact.plantation_deceased_contrib_3y: Had the member who died paid contributions to the Fund for at least 3 years?
fact.plantation_deceased_worked_15y: Had the member who died worked in a small plantation for at least 15 years?
fact.plantation_medical_treatment: Has the member or a family member had medical treatment for which you want help with the bills?
fact.plantation_child_class10: Is a child of the member studying in Class X or in a higher course?
fact.mother_age_19: Is the woman who is expecting or has given birth at least 19 years old?
